reason: Unconditioned joint four-frame model preserves digit identity but often generates nearly static clips, consistent with averaging opposite training motions
architecture: Initialize four-frame UNet from joint_ema.pt, expand input from four noisy-frame channels to six by adding x/y velocity channels with zero initial weights; keep four predicted-noise output channels
data: Same MNIST moving-digit generator but explicit velocity vx,vy=±2 pixels/frame; conditioning maps give vx/2 and vy/2
sampling: 20-step stochastic DDIM eta=1, cosine schedule, t_min=20, x0 clipped to [-1,1], fixed velocity from seed
baseline_gate: At least 6/8 finite clips with ink mass 0.03-0.40, independent digit confidence >=0.7, independent frame-class consistency >=0.75, centroid movement >=0.7 pixels, and centroid displacement cosine >=0.5 toward requested velocity; inspect grid. The upper ink threshold was revised after observing the prior joint-model grid and is not a confirmatory reuse of its seeds.
stop_rule: No GRPO unless new fixed-seed baseline gate and visual inspection pass; stop nonfinite training; no paid compute
claim_scope: Locally trained conditional toy-video model, not external pretrained video or cinematic generation
